note: Mutants of tools/hud_art/pack.py: sprites that do not fit a texture go on a second page instead of failing (the page rule is tools/art_sheets.py's, with its own mutants: art_sheets_mutants.json): the derived sprites stay on the first page, every sprite is where its record says, the records name the pages. Each must be noticed by tests/scripts/test_hud_art_pack.py. No build: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/hud_art_pack_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1, from the repository folder.

mutants.old: art_sheets.sheet_rows({(index, k): (files[(index, k)], sheet_w * k, sheet_h * k) for index, (sheet_w, sheet_h, _, _) in enumerate(sheets) for k in scales})
mutants.new: art_sheets.sheet_rows({(0, k): (files[(0, k)], sheets[0][0] * k, sheets[0][1] * k) for k in scales})

mutants.old: line = 'sprite %s %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %s %s' % (r['name'], which, w, h, sx, sy, x0, y0, r['anchor'][0], r['anchor'][1])
mutants.new: line = 'sprite %s %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %s %s' % (r['name'], 0, w, h, sx, sy, x0, y0, r['anchor'][0], r['anchor'][1])

mutants.old: pages = art_sheets.fill_pages(sizes_rest, lambda page, chunk: fit(sizes_top if page == 0 else [], chunk))
mutants.new: pages = art_sheets.fill_pages(sizes_rest, lambda page, chunk: fit(sizes_top if page == 0 else [], chunk) if len(chunk) <= 1 else None, max_pages=60)
